paper.title_en: Purely quadratic non-Gaussianity from tachyonic instability: Primordial black holes and scalar-induced gravitational waves
paper.abstract_en: We investigate primordial black hole (PBH) formation in a cosmological scenario where curvature perturbations follow purely quadratic non-Gaussianity, $ζ= A(φ^2-langleφ^2\rangle)$, arising from tachyonic instability in multicomponent inflationary models. Within an extended Press-Schechter framework based on the compaction function, we derive the probability distribution of the linear compaction function and its asymptotic exponential tail, demonstrating that the PBH abundance is exponentially sensitive not only to the amplitude of perturbations but also to the correlation coefficient $ρ$ between the smoothed field and its radial gradient. We further find that, in this tachyonic amplification scenario, the spectral width of the curvature power spectrum plays a decisive role in avoiding PBH overproduction: broad spectra yield mildly negative $ρ$ and fail to suppress PBH formation, while sufficiently narrow spectra drive $ρ\to -1$, resulting in exponential suppression while maintaining a sizable gravitational-wave signal. Thermal inflation serves as a benchmark for asteroid-mass PBH dark matter and high-frequency scalar-induced gravitational waves potentially detectable by future space-based interferometers, but its typically broad spectra make it challenging to reconcile pulsar timing array observations with PBH constraints.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文研究来自快子不稳定性的纯二次非高斯性导致的原始黑洞形成和标量诱导引力波，与脉冲星计时阵列和黑洞热力学相关，理论深度高，方法严谨，新颖性强。
decision.title_zh: 来自快子不稳定性的纯二次非高斯性：原始黑洞和标量诱导引力波
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在宇宙学情景中原始黑洞的形成，其中曲率扰动遵循纯二次非高斯性，$ζ= A(φ^2-\langleφ^2\rangle)$，该情景源于多组分暴胀模型中的快子不稳定性。在基于压实函数的扩展Press-Schechter框架内，我们推导了线性压实函数的概率分布及其渐近指数尾部，证明了原始黑洞丰度不仅对扰动幅度指数敏感，而且对平滑场与其径向梯度之间的相关系数$ρ$也指数敏感。我们进一步发现，在这种快子放大情景中，曲率功率谱的谱宽在避免原始黑洞过度产生方面起着决定性作用：宽谱产生弱负的$ρ$，无法抑制原始黑洞形成，而足够窄的谱使$ρ\to -1$，导致指数抑制同时保持可观的引力波信号。热暴胀作为小行星质量原始黑洞暗物质和未来空间干涉仪潜在可探测的高频标量诱导引力波的基准，但其典型的宽谱使得协调脉冲星计时阵列观测与原始黑洞约束变得困难。
